Cracks Beneath the AI Boom: Is the U.S. Economy Heading For a Downturn? | The Weekly Wrap

The November 7 wrap connects narrow equity leadership with a divided economy, reviews AI expectations and warns that expensive stocks need more than merely good results. It also revisits FICO competition and explains banking money creation.

YouTube · 2025-11-07 ↗Substack · 2025-11-09 ↗
His warnings about valuation expectations and product differentiation are useful. The no-sales-force Palantir description is false, and the money-creation lesson conflates deposits, capital and reserves. Equity-index concentration is observable but does not itself prove that the rest of the economy has stopped growing.

youtube-HQ2jMo_wZXc-c002 · analytical principle

Equal-weight indexes reveal market participation concealed by megacap weights.

Right
Source · 2:58-3:48 ↗
SpeakerSteve Eisman
Stanceasserted
Horizonnot stated
Materialitymajor

A capitalization-weighted average and an equally weighted average answer different questions. The return gap measures dispersion in contributions, subject to rebalancing.

Conditional reasoning

Cap weighting gives more influence to larger initial weights; equal weighting assigns equal initial weights. Their return difference reveals the effect of weighting, not directly the GDP contribution of each firm.

  • Use the same constituent universe and time interval.

Assessment test: Use matching total-return series and rebalance conventions.

Evidence and assessment details

Attribution confidence: high. Assessment confidence: medium. Thesis family: index_concentration.

No independent empirical outcome evidence is attached. A principle, disclosure or unfinished forecast is not a verified investment win.

It demonstrates stock-market concentration; firms listed in the index and their weights do not map directly to household incomes or domestic value added.

Conditional reasoning

An index can become concentrated through valuation changes without a corresponding shift in current household income or GDP. Therefore market concentration alone cannot prove a particular real-economy distribution.

  • Market capitalization reflects expected global equity cash flows, not current domestic output.

Assessment test: Compare market concentration with independent employment, spending and GDP data.

youtube-HQ2jMo_wZXc-c021 · explanation

A bank keeps roughly 10% of a deposit as capital or liquidity and repeatedly relends the rest to create money.

Wrong
Source · 22:10-23:23 ↗
SpeakerSteve Eisman
Stanceasserted
Horizonnot stated
Materialitymajor

This conflates capital, reserves and liquidity. US transaction reserve requirements were zero, and modern lending creates a matching deposit rather than mechanically multiplying a prior deposit under a 10% rule.

Assessment test: Follow loan/deposit balance-sheet entries and separate capital, liquidity and settlement constraints.

Evidence and assessment details

Attribution confidence: high. Assessment confidence: medium. Thesis family: money_creation.

  • Reserve requirements
    Transaction-account reserve requirements were reduced to zero in March 2020. Capital and liquidity constraints remain separate requirements.
  • Money creation in the modern economy · 2014-03-14
    Bank lending creates a matching deposit; banks do not simply lend out a fixed fraction of prior deposits under a mechanical money multiplier. Profitability, capital, liquidity and monetary policy constrain lending.

How he reasons here

  • Look beneath capitalization-weighted headline indexes.
  • Distinguish operating growth from what the valuation requires.
  • Avoid shorting solely because a successful company is expensive.
  • Prefer differentiated products over easily substituted hardware.
